<js>
var out = '';
try {
    // 抛弃正则，直接用字符串分割，完美避开嵌套大括号被截断的问题
    var parts = String(result).split('var player_aaaa=');
    if (parts.length > 1) {
        // 截取到 </script> 之前的内容
        var jsonStr = parts[1].split('</script>')[0].trim();
        // 如果末尾有分号，则去掉分号，确保是纯净的 JSON
        if (jsonStr.charAt(jsonStr.length - 1) === ';') {
            jsonStr = jsonStr.slice(0, -1);
        }
        
        var data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        var url = String(data.url);
        
        if (data.encrypt == 2) {
            var b64Str = String(java.base64Decode(url));
            url = decodeURIComponent(b64Str);
        } else if (data.encrypt == 1) {
            url = decodeURIComponent(url);
        }
        
        out = '' + url.replace(/\\\//g, '/');
    } else {
        out = '⚠️ 解析失败，源码中未找到 player_aaaa 配置。';
    }
} catch(e) {
    out = '⚠️ 解析异常：' + String(e);
}
out;
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
list = [];
data = JSON.parse(src).data;
chargeContUrlPrefix = data.chargeContUrlPrefix;
freeContUrlPrefix = data.freeContUrlPrefix;
shortContUrlPrefix = data.shortContUrlPrefix;
chapterList = data.chapterList;
var sqMetaMap = {};
var sqShortMap = {};
var sqCatalogBookId = "";
try { sqCatalogBookId = String(bookId || ""); } catch(e) {}
if (!sqCatalogBookId) {
  var sqBookMatch = String(baseUrl || "").match(/bookId=(\d+)/);
  if (sqBookMatch) sqCatalogBookId = sqBookMatch[1];
}
function sqFmtCatalogTime(ts) {
  var d = new Date(Number(ts || 0) * 1000);
  if (!Number(ts || 0)) return "";
  function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : String(n); }
  return d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate()) + " " + pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes());
}
for (i in chapterList) {
  volumeName = chapterList[i].volumeName;
  list.push({ chapterName: "🏮〖" + volumeName + "〗🏮", isVolume: true });
  chapterList[i].volumeList.forEach($ => {
    var suffix = String($.contUrlSuffix || "");
    var realChapterUrl = ($.isFreeRead ? freeContUrlPrefix : chargeContUrlPrefix) + suffix;
    realChapterUrl = String(realChapterUrl || "").replace(/0$/, "1");
    var currentBookId = String(sqCatalogBookId || "");
    var currentChapterId = String($.chapterId || "");
    chapterUrl = realChapterUrl;
    shortUrl = shortContUrlPrefix + String($.shortContUrlSuffix || "");
    time = sqFmtCatalogTime($.chapterUpdateTime);
    wordCount = $.wordCount + "字";
    chapterPrice = $.chapterPrice != "0" && !$.isFreeRead ? $.chapterPrice + "书豆" : "";
    if (suffix) {
      sqMetaMap[suffix] = { bookId: currentBookId, chapterId: currentChapterId };
      if (shortUrl) sqShortMap[suffix] = shortUrl;
    }
    list.push({
      chapterName: $.chapterName,
      chapterUrl: chapterUrl,
      isVip: !$.isFreeRead,
      isPay: $.isBuy,
      chapterInfo: [volumeName, time, wordCount, chapterPrice].join("丨").replace(/丨$/, "")
    });
  });
}
try {
  java.put("sqMetaMap", JSON.stringify(sqMetaMap));
  java.put("sqShortMap", JSON.stringify(sqShortMap));
  _sqMetaMapCache = null;
  _sqShortMapCache = null;
} catch(eMap) {}
list
</js>

var root = JSON.parse(result);
var list = [];
var seen = {};
function addNovel(items) {
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        var info = items[i].bookInfo || items[i];
        if (!info || !info.bookId) continue;
        list.push({_media:"novel", id:String(info.bookId), title:info.title, author:info.author,
            intro:info.intro, kind:info.category, cover:info.cover, lastChapter:info.lastChapterIdx});
    }
}
function addAudio(items) {
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        var info = items[i].albumInfo || items[i];
        if (!info || !info.albumId || seen[String(info.albumId)]) continue;
        seen[String(info.albumId)] = true;
        list.push({_media:"audio", id:String(info.albumId), title:info.name, author:info.authorName || info.bookAuthor,
            intro:info.intro, kind:info.themeTag || "听书", cover:info.cover,
            lastChapter:info.firstTrackTitle, trackCount:info.trackCount});
    }
}
if (root.books) addNovel(root.books);
else {
    var firstAudioPage = typeof page == 'undefined' || Number(page) <= 1;
    if (root.albums) addAudio(root.albums);
    if (root.items) addAudio(root.items);
    if (firstAudioPage && root.ranklist && root.ranklist.itemList) addAudio(root.ranklist.itemList);
    if (firstAudioPage && root.recommendList) addAudio(root.recommendList);
    if (root.itemList) addAudio(root.itemList);
    if (root.results) {
        for (var resultIndex = 0; resultIndex < root.results.length; resultIndex++) {
            var group = root.results[resultIndex] || {};
            if (group.albums) addAudio(group.albums);
        }
    }
}
result = JSON.stringify(list);
</js>$[*]

by狼崽儿 //2026.7.27
原作者ljy911028
登录接口默认第一个。部分作品需要先登录才能访问。
如果是第一次使用某个接口，可以先登录再搜索，阅读会长期保存该接口的登录状态。但是不同接口都需要单独登录，如果切换到第一次使用的域名，切记记得登录。
没有测试接口快慢的功能，所以需要自己慢慢试哪个接口可以用❤️（2026.8.26 已完全移除此功能）
//2026.8.28   by狼崽儿
【V2大更新❗️】【请仔细看源注释❗️】
1.众所周知，漫蛙的子域名太多了，硬编码的子域名组已经无法适应变化。所以本版本采用自定义输入网址后缀的两个字母来访问国内子站。
    〔👉使用攻略〕①（已经知道可用地址的小伙伴去第②步）
    如果你不知道现在哪个漫蛙的域名可以用，可以复制发布页https://mwmissing8.cc在浏览器打开，或者直接点击登录处的发布页，进去点击备用地址等待重定向，成功进入漫蛙后观察上面的域名，比如当前域名是https://manwapm.cc，记住它，或者直接复制。
      ②模板：https://manwapm.cc
    该网址的后缀是pm，所以直接在自定义域名输入pm，点击右上角√保存（一定要保存！）
     支持粘贴pm、https://manwapm.cc、https://manwapm.cc/、manwapm.cc、https://manwapm.cc///
      ③默认域名是漫蛙主域名https://manwa.me，需要挂梯使用。如果想回退到该域名，点击清除自定义以后❌不要点击√，直接返回。或者删除所有自定义域名字母并点击清除自定义后保存。
      ④(可选)登录篇
    某些🔞作品需要登录才能搜索得到。应在填写好域名之后点击💡登录页面💡，跳转至真正的登录页登录（确保已开启CookieJar）。依然是没有登录过的网站需要重新登录。
    Q：为什么不能直接在阅读里登录呢？
    A：因为登录强制需要输入验证码，目前我没找到什么控件可以在登录显示验证码。
    Q：如何验证已经登录了？
    A：我在搜索的校验关键词放了一个隐藏作品的名字，你们去校验的时候发现出来的不是这本书就说明无登录cookie。你们也可以更换成其他隐藏作品自行校验。
    
2.发现页在自定义域名后，旧版书源需要在探索页长按此源刷新。
   ①保持了原作者的标签添加简易性。想要添加新标签，直接复制上一个标签到下一行，然后替换里面的文字就可以了。
   ②新增了⭐ 我的收藏。登录之后即可在探索页查看收藏书柜。为了避免不爱登录的小伙伴校验失败，所以⭐ 我的收藏放置在了分类和标签中间的位置。
    ps:如果查看失败，大概率是曾经清除过cookie，重新在登录页面登录。（校验搜索会出现隐藏作品不代表仍然处于登录状态，只能证明当初已经登录过的cookie仍然在发挥作用）小概率是网站负担过重，主动关闭了收藏书柜的查看功能，过一段时间再查看。
     因为本人从来都没有在网站上收藏的习惯，所以为了测验此功能而临时收藏的书籍数量少，在测试时并没有出现bug，具体使用情况你们自行辨别一下。
3.使用小贴士❤️
如果遇到高峰期不出图，可以尝试挂梯。虽然漫蛙的国内子域名网站挂梯之后是进不去的，但是图片都是海外的主站服务器返回的。挂梯之后会使阅读更快接收到图片。

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var bookid = baseUrl.match(/novel\/(\d+)/)[1];
//书评发送
const bookva = book.getVariable("custom");
if (bookva && bookva != "") {
    if (source.getLoginHeader()) {
        const commenturl = `${GetUL()}/home/comment/add.html`;
        let body = `content=${bookva}&type=novel&mid=${bookid}`;
        
        try {
            const code = String(java.getVerificationCode(`data:image/svg+xml;base64,${codesvg}`));
            
            if (code == "评论" || /^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                if (/^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                    body += `&pid=${code.match(/(\d+)/)[1]}`;
                }
                
                const headers = { "x-requested-with": "XMLHttpRequest" };
                const response = java.post(commenturl, body, headers).body();
                java.toast(JSON.parse(response).msg);
            } else {
                Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(40);
                java.toast('请按图片要求填写');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            java.log(err);
        }
    } else {
        java.toast("未登录，请登录后操作");
    }
    book.putCustomVariable("");
}

try {
    sourceinfo = source.getLoginInfoMap();
    sourceinfo['书籍ID'] = bookid;
    if (bookid) {
        source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(sourceinfo));
    }
    $ = _ => String(java.getString(_));
    img = /^https?/.test($('[property$=image]@content')) ? $('[property$=image]@content') : GetUL() + $('[property$=image]@content');
    list = {
        "ID": bookid,
        "img": img,
        "name": $('[property$=book_name]@content'),
        "author": $('[property$=author]@content'),
        "info": $('[property$=description]@content').slice(0, 45),
        "url": "legado://import/addToBookshelf?src=" + baseUrl
    }
    source.put("list", JSON.stringify(list));
} catch (err) {
    java.log("登录UI未初始化保存数据：" + err);
}
src;
</js>

bookSourceComment:
完本神站（m.wanbenshenzhan.com）
搜索通过搜搜书(sososhu.com)搜索引擎进行，需登录后使用。
【技术实现】
搜索：sososhu.com 搜索（GET /?s={{key}}&web=38kanshu）
  - 搜索结果由 JS 从 Base64 编码的 JSON 动态渲染
  - bookList 规则直接从 HTML 提取 Base64 数据并解码，不依赖 WebView
  - 搜索结果链接指向 m.wanbenshenzhan.com
发现：wanbenshenzhan.com 书库/排行榜（表格+卡片两种布局）
详情：wanbenshenzhan.com CSS 选择器
目录：wanbenshenzhan.com CSS 选择器（?chapter_page=N 分页）
正文：wanbenshenzhan.com CSS 选择器
【登录说明】
- 登录需填写手机号、密码、图形验证码。
- 点击「刷新验证码」会在浏览器中打开验证码图片，查看后返回输入。
- 登录成功后自动保存 Cookie，后续请求自动携带。
- 登出按钮可清除 Cookie 和登录状态。
- ★ 「签 到」按钮：登录后点击即可完成每日签到，成功后 Toast 提示。
- ★ 搜索时自动检测签到状态，若未签到则自动签到。
【局限性】
- 搜索需要登录：未登录访问搜索会跳转登录页，请先登录。
- 搜索每账号每天限 8 次。
- 搜索结果搜索次数提示会自动 Toast 显示剩余次数和签到状态。
- 搜索结果 URL 中的 token 参数已自动去除，避免过期问题。

    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util
);
with (javaImporter) {
    function decode(content) {
        var ivEncryptedData = Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(content));
        var secretKey = SecretKeySpec(String("242ccb8230d709e1").getBytes(), "AES");
        var ivParameter = IvParameterSpec(Arrays.copyOfRange(ivEncryptedData, 0, 16));
        var cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        cipher.init(2, secretKey, ivParameter);
        return String(cipher.doFinal(Arrays.copyOfRange(ivEncryptedData, 16, ivEncryptedData.length)));
    }
}

  }
  if(!found){
    var s0=items[0].match(/data-src="([^"]*)"/);
    if(s0){found='https://www.yssm5.xyz'+s0[1]}
  }
  found;
}

<js>
var html=result;
var start=html.indexOf('bookshelf-list');
var section=start>=0?html.substring(start):'';
var chapters=[];
var re=/<a[^>]*href="(\/book\/\d+\/[^"]+)"[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/a>/g;
var m;
var nav=['科幻小说','恐怖小说','其他小说','会员书架','阅读记录','首页','玄幻小说','仙侠小说','都市小说','历史小说','网游小说','武侠小说','言情小说','青春小说','穿越小说','惊悚小说','修真小说','首  页','首页'];
while((m=re.exec(section))!==null){
  var name=m[2].trim();
  if(nav.indexOf(name)===-1){
    chapters.push({'name':name,'url':m[1]})
  }
}
result=JSON.stringify(chapters)
</js>

function qmVideoState(kind) {

  try {

    var state = saved ? JSON.parse(String(saved)) : null
    if (state && state.pages) return state
  } catch (e) {}
  return {pages:{}}
}

function qmVideoUploadIds(kind, page) {
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  if (page == '1') {
    qmResetVideoState.call(this, kind)
    return []
  }
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var ids = []
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b) }).forEach(function (key) {
    if (Number(key) < Number(page)) ids = ids.concat(state.pages[key] || [])
  })
  var seen = {}
  return ids.filter(function (id) { id = String(id); if (!id || seen[id]) return false; seen[id] = 1; return true }).slice(-120).map(function (id) {
    return {id:String(id),item_type:kind == 'animated' ? '14' : '11',ts:String(Date.now()),type:'0'}
  })
}

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered
}

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {
  var ctx = this
  if (node == null || depth > 8) return
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    node.forEach(function (item) { qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, item, mode, output, seen, depth + 1) })
    return
  }
  if (typeof node != 'object') return
  var itemMode = mode == 'publish' ? 'novel' : mode
  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {
    var key = mode + '-' + id
    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = 1
      output.push(qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, node, itemMode, mode))
    }
  }
  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!/^(meta|stat_params|track_id|tag_items|category_list|rank_list)$/.test(key)) {
      qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, node[key], mode, output, seen, depth + 1)
    }
  })
}

function qmDateText(value) {
  var seconds = Number(value || 0)
  if (!seconds) return ''
  var date = new Date(seconds > 9999999999 ? seconds : seconds * 1000)

  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + two(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + two(date.getDate()) + ' ' + two(date.getHours()) + ':' + two(date.getMinutes())
}

function qmNovelInfo(raw) {
  raw = raw || {}
  var info = {}
  Object.keys(raw).forEach(function (key) { info[key] = raw[key] })
  var tags = (raw.book_tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return String(x.title || '') }).filter(function (x) { return !!x })
  var attribute = raw.attribute || {}
  var extras = attribute.extra_info_list || []
  function findExtra(pattern) {
    for (var i = 0; i < extras.length; i++) {
      if (pattern.test(String(extras[i].sub_title || extras[i].title || ''))) return qmExtraInfoText(extras[i])
    }
    return ''
  }
  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)
  if (score && String(score).indexOf('分') < 0) score = String(score) + '分'
  var reading = ''
  var readingList = attribute.reading_info_list || []
  if (readingList.length > 2) reading = qmExtraInfoText(readingList[2]) || String(readingList[2].title || readingList[2].text || '')
  if (!reading) reading = findExtra(/正在阅读|在线/)
  var lines = []
  var updated = qmDateText(raw.update_time)
  if (updated) lines.push('🧭 更新：' + updated)
  if (raw.category_over_words) lines.push('📒 关于：' + raw.category_over_words)
  if (score) lines.push('💯 分数：' + score)
  if (reading) lines.push('👁️ 在线：' + reading)
  if (tags.length) lines.push('🏷️ 标签：' + tags.join(' / '))
  if (raw.characters) lines.push('👥 角色：' + raw.characters)
  if (raw.publisher) lines.push('🏢 出版：' + raw.publisher)
  if (raw.isbn) lines.push('🔖 ISBN：' + raw.isbn)
  var copyright = raw.statement || raw.source_name
  if (copyright) lines.push('📍 版权来源：' + copyright)
  if (raw.intro) lines.push('📄 简介：' + raw.intro)
  info.id = String(raw.id || '')
  info.author = raw.author || raw.author_name || ''
  info.image_link = raw.big_image_link || raw.image_link || raw.thumb_image_link || ''
  info.intro = lines.join('\n')
  info.kind = [raw.category_over_words].concat(tags).filter(function (x) { return !!x }).join(',')
  info.last_chapter = raw.latest_chapter_title || raw.chapter_list_desc || ''
  info.words_num = raw.words_num || raw.word_count || ''
  return info
}

      intro:raw.intro,kind:(raw.book_tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return x.title }).join(','),

    try { if (runtimeBook) runtimeBook.type = 32 } catch (e) {}

    }

}

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {
    input = input || {}
    var ctx = this
    var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
    var kind = String(input.kind || 'paragraph')
    var cursor = String(input.cursor || '')
    var response
    var data
    var list = []
    var tags = []
    var total = ''
    var next = ''
    if (kind == 'book') {
      var bookId = String(input.bookId || '')
      var bookHot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1'
      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}
      if (cursor) bp.next_id = cursor

      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')
      tags = (evaluateInfo.tag_list || data.tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return {id:String(x.id || x.tag_id || '1'),title:String(x.title || x.name || '全部'),count:String(x.count || x.comment_count || '')} })
    } else {
      var hot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1' ? '1' : '0'
      var params = {book_id:String(input.bookId || ''),chapter_id:String(input.chapterId || '')}
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor
        response = qmGet.call(ctx, moreUrl, params)
      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'
        if (kind == 'chapter') params.extra = ''
        response = qmPostForm.call(ctx, firstUrl, params)
      }
      data = response.data || {}
      if (cursor) {
        list = (data.comment_list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) })
        next = String(data.next_id || '')
      } else {
        var hotZone = data.hot_zone || {}

        var hotList = hotZone.comment_list || []
        var timeList = timeZone.comment_list || []

function qmOpenComment(kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId) {
  var html = qmCommentHtml.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId)
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'showBrowser')) return false
  runtimeJava.showBrowser('https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/', html, 'window.java=java;window.cache=cache;window.source=source;window.qmRun=run;window.qmLocalCommentPage=true;', JSON.stringify({state:4,isHideable:true,heightPercentage:cfg.height,widthPercentage:1.0,dismissOnTouchOutside:true,skipCollapsed:true,expandedCornersRadius:16,isGestureInsetBottomIgnored:true,hardwareAccelerated:true,webViewInitialScale:100}))
  return true
}

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var normalizedKind = String(kind || '')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var color = cfg.color
  count = Number(count || 0)
  if (count <= 0) return ''
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph' && cfg.split) color = hot ? cfg.hotColor : count >= cfg.splitCount ? cfg.splitColor : cfg.color
  count = Math.min(count, 999)
  var svg
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph') {
    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :
      '<svg viewBox="5 14 45 36" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="180" height="144"><path d="M44 48 Q48 48 48 44 L48 20 Q48 16 44 16 L20 16 Q16 16 16 20 L16 24 S16 28 10 30 Q6 32 10 34 Q16 36 16 38 L16 44 Q16 48 20 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.7"/><text x="32" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="' + color + '" dominant-baseline="middle">' + displayText + '</text></svg>'
  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="6" y="6" width="988" height="116" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="3"/><text x="48" y="79" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="' + color + '">' + qmEsc(label) + '</text><text x="950" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="34" fill="' + color + '">' + count + ' 条 ›</text></svg>'
  } else {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="150" y="150" width="665" height="525" rx="175" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="18"/><text x="480" y="535" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="middle" font-size="298" fill="' + color + '">' + count + '</text></svg>'
  }
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + [normalizedKind, bid, cid, pid, label || '', checkId || ''].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var style = normalizedKind == 'paragraph' ? qmCommentConfig.call(this).svgSize : 'FULL'
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:style,type:'qmpl',click:call})
}

function qmBubbleImage(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var data = qmSvg.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot)
  return data ? '<img src="' + data + '">' : ''
}

function qmGodImage(bid, cid, pid, gid, text) {
  text = String(text || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim()
  if (!gid || !text) return ''
  if (text.length > 18) text = text.slice(0, 18) + '...'
  var svg = '<svg width="1000" height="120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' +
    '<rect x="2" y="0" width="996" height="100" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" rx="35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>' +
    '<rect x="32" y="22" width="140" height="56" rx="20" fill="#FF4444"/>' +
    '<text x="102" y="64" font-size="32" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">神评</text>' +
    '<text x="196" y="64" font-size="38" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">' + qmEsc(text) + '</text></svg>'
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + ['paragraph', bid, cid, pid, '七猫神评', gid].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var data = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:'FULL',type:'qmpl-god',click:call})
  return '<img src="' + data + '">'
}

function qmChapterReviewCount(bid, cid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-chapter-' + bid + '-' + cid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/comment/chapter-end-comment', {book_id:bid,chapter_ids:cid}).data || {}
  var comments = data.comments || []
  var count = comments.length ? Number(comments[0].count || 0) : 0
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmBookReviewCount(bid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-book-' + bid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', {circle_id:bid,need_common:'0',tag_id:'1',book_id:bid,sort:'0'}).data || {}
  var count = Number(data.evaluates_info && data.evaluates_info.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || 0)
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmContentTitle(value, baseUrl) {
  var text = String(value || '')
  var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
  try { if (runtimeChapter) runtimeChapter.putImgUrl(null) } catch (e) {}
  return text
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

<js>
var html = String(result);
var d = html.match(/initTxt\("([^"]+)"/);
if (!d) '内容加载失败';
else {
    var u = d[1];
    if (u.indexOf('//') === 0) u = 'https:' + u;
    var s = String(java.ajax(u));
    var j = s.match(/_txt_call\((\{[\s\S]*\})\)/);
    if (!j) '解析失败';
    else {
        var c = j[1].match(/"content"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)"\s*,\s*"replace"/);
        if (!c) c = j[1].match(/"content"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)"/);
        if (!c) '无content';
        else {
            var ct = c[1].replace(/\\n/g,'\n').replace(/\\r/g,'\r').replace(/\\t/g,'\t').replace(/\\"/g,'"').replace(/\\\\/g,'\\');
            var r = /"([^"]+)"\s*:\s*"((?:\\b|\\n|[\s\S]))"/g;
            var m;
            while ((m = r.exec(j[1])) !== null) {
                ct = ct.split(m[2]).join(m[1]);
            }
            ct = ct.replace(/&#x([0-9a-fA-F]+);/g, function(_, h) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16)) });
            ct = ct.replace(/&#(\d+);/g, function(_, d) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(d, 10)) });
            var b = html.match(/ttf;base64,([^\)]+)/);
            if (b) try { ct = String(java.replaceFont(ct, java.queryBase64TTF(b[1]), java.queryTTF("https://alanskycn.gitee.io/teachme/assets/font/Source Han Sans CN Regular.ttf"), true)) } catch(e) {}
            ct = ct.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
            ct.split('\n').filter(function(l) { return l.trim() && !/AILISW|ailisw|温馨提示|加载中/.test(l) }).join('\n');
        }
    }
}
</js>

<js>
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result), baseUrl);
var arr = [];
var seen = {};
// 1. 封面推荐卡片 .col-md-6.mb-3
var cards = doc.select(".col-md-6.mb-3");
for(var i=0;i<cards.size();i++){
  var card = cards.get(i);
  var titleA = card.select("h6.book-title a").first();
  if(titleA == null) continue;
  var url = titleA.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = titleA.text().trim();
  var authorEl = card.select("p.book-author").first();
  var author = authorEl ? authorEl.text().replace("作者：","").trim() : "";
  var coverEl = card.select("img.book-cover").first();
  var cover = coverEl ? coverEl.attr("abs:src") : "";
  var introEl = card.select("p.book-desc").first();
  var intro = introEl ? introEl.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:cover, intro:intro});
}
// 2. 最新入库列表 ul.new-book-list li
var newItems = doc.select("ul.new-book-list li");
for(var i=0;i<newItems.size();i++){
  var li = newItems.get(i);
  var a = li.select("a").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var span = li.select("span").first();
  var author = span ? span.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:""});
}
// 3. 编辑推荐列表 ul.latest-list li
var latestItems = doc.select("ul.latest-list li");
for(var i=0;i<latestItems.size();i++){
  var li = latestItems.get(i);
  var a = li.select("a.latest-title").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var span = li.select("span.latest-author").first();
  var author = span ? span.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:""});
}
// 4. 最近更新表格 table.update-table tbody tr
var rows = doc.select("table.update-table tbody tr");
for(var i=0;i<rows.size();i++){
  var tr = rows.get(i);
  var tds = tr.select("td");
  if(tds.size() < 2) continue;
  var a = tds.get(0).select("a").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var author = tds.get(1).text().trim();
  var lastCh = tds.size() > 2 ? tds.get(2).text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:lastCh});
}
JSON.stringify(arr)
</js>

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
r=`走出便利商店要回家的高中生 菜月・昴（Natsuki・Subaru） 突然被召唤到异世界。

这莫非就是很流行的异世界召唤！？可是眼前没有召唤者就算了，还遭遇强盗迅速面临性命危机。

这时，一名神秘银发美少女和猫精灵拯救了一筹莫展的他。

以报恩为名义，昴自告奋勇要帮助少女找回失物。

然而，好不容易才掌握到线索，昴和少女却被不明人士攻击而殒命 ── 本来应该是这样，但回过神来，昴却发现自己置身在第一次被召唤到这个异世界时的所在位置。

『死亡回归』 —— 无力的少年得到的唯一能力，是死后时间会倒转回到一开始。

※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

仅仅是作为没有被赋予任何关于异世界知识、技能、力量的普通人，挣扎求存。 他唯一得到的祝福就是 「重生」 —— 触发条件是痛苦的 『死亡』 ！

他死了多少次？ 历经多少死亡方式（剧透慎点）？ 在不可靠的世界种如何夺取希望之物？

但即使跨越无数血液、尸体和绝望，也要从死亡的命运中拯救少女！`
</js>

(function(){
    var html = String(result);
    var idx = html.indexOf("player_aaaa");
    if (idx < 0) return "";
    var start = html.indexOf("{", idx);
    if (start < 0) return "";
    var depth = 0;
    var end = start;
    for (var i = start; i < html.length; i++) {
        if (html.charAt(i) === "{") depth++;
        else if (html.charAt(i) === "}") {
            depth--;
            if (depth === 0) {
                end = i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    var jsonStr = html.substring(start, end + 1);
    try {
        var data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        return data.url || "";
    } catch(e) {
        return "";
    }
})()
</js>

source_url = baseUrl.replace('/details/','/source/');

$ = JSON.parse(decode(source_info));

v=String(book.getVariable("custom"));
x=v.match(/^\d+$/)?v:0;
x=parseInt(x)<$.length?x:0;

result.updated_at = $[x].updated_at;
result.last_chapter_name = $[x].last_chapter_name;
result.tocUrl = source.getKey().replace('//s','//catalog')+"/"+$[x].site_path;
result.image = source.getKey().replace('//s','//res') + '/'+result.image;


if($.length>1){
		y = '\n📌使用说明： 根据序号设置书籍变量来切换来源(默认0)\n🎯当前源：序号🔺'+x+'🔻【'+$[x].site_name+'】'+(x==0?' (默认)':'');
for(i in $){
		y += '\n❤序号🔺'+i+'🔻【'+$[i].site_name+'】 \n选用率：'+$[i].choose+' \n更新时间： '+$[i].updated_at+'\n最新章节： '+$[i].last_chapter_name;
	}
result.remark += y
}


result = JSON.stringify(result);
</js>

var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
$=java.getString('.leftx@html')
n = 0; 
v = book.getVariable("custom");
x = v.match(/^\d+$/)? v : n;
//x = (parseInt(x) < $.length)? x : n;
java.toast(x)
name=java.getString('.bookTitle@text');
author=`{{book.author}}`;
last=java.getString('#list-chapterAll@a@text')
kind=java.getString('.col-md-12@p.1@text')

if (v == 0) {
  bookUrlz = baseUrl;
  book.type = 8;
  java.toast('已自动开启小说模式');
} else if(v==1){
  bookUrlz =String(java.getString('.leftx@a@onclick')).replace(/.*\(\'(.*?)\'\)/,'$1');
  book.type = 128;
  java.toast('已自动开启文件模式');
}
intro = " 简介：" + java.getString('.bookIntro@text') + "\n当前源链: " + "\n"+bookUrlz+"\n书籍文本:🔺'+【0】+'🔻"+'\n'+baseUrl+
"\n文件链接:🔺'+【1】+'🔻"+'\n'+String(java.getString('.leftx@a@onclick')).replace(/.*\(\'(.*?)\'\)/,'$1');
data = {
	name:name,
	author:author,
	last:last,
	kind:kind,
	intro:intro,
	bookUrl:bookUrlz
};

JSON.stringify(data);
</js>

R=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(temp).select(".BCsectionTwo-top-chapter a")
c=[]
R.forEach(r=>{
	i=String(r.attr('href')).replace(/.+\/\d+\/(\d+)\.html/,`$1`)
	//java.log(i)
	c.push({
		name:r.text(),
		url:r.attr('href'),

try{

	o=o.split(",")
	c.sort((a,b)=>o[c.indexOf(a)]-o[c.indexOf(b)])

		java.log(err)

		}
	result=c
</js>

bookSourceComment:
五八书阁（m.5859ycdh.com）
免费小说阅读网站，无需登录，无搜索次数限制。
【技术实现】
搜索：POST /search/（body: q={{key}}），不支持分页
发现：分类目录（/wuba131/~139/）+ 书库 + 排行榜 + 完本
  - 分类/书库/排行榜支持 ?page={{page}} 分页
  - 完本不支持分页（固定100本）
详情：/wuba/{bookId}/ CSS 选择器
目录：/wuba/{bookId}/list.html（全量章节，无分页）
正文：/wubashu/{bookId}/{chapterId}.html（章节内分页，#PageSet）
【URL 规律】
书籍详情：/wuba/{bookId}/
章节目录：/wuba/{bookId}/list.html
正文页面：/wubashu/{bookId}/{chapterId}.html
正文分页：{chapterId}-{pageNum}.html
【规则语法说明】
- 详情页：用 Default规则语法(class.B@tag.dd.1@...) 和 CSS类选择器(span.ml, span.c)
- 发现/搜索页：用 Default规则语法(tag.dd.1@...)，因为CSS选择器不支持数字索引
- 发现页 dl.B（大卡片）和 dl.S（小卡片）共存，bookList 用逗号合并
- 部分页面图片使用 data-src 懒加载，已用 || 兼容
- 正文末尾有广告文本，已用正则清理
- 正文有内分页，已配置 nextContentUrl
- 编码：UTF-8

const list = [];
const push = (title,url,size) => list.push({
	 title,
	 url,
	 style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: size}
});


function getHost(sn, cfg) {
  var v = source.getVariable();
  if (v) {
    v = trimSlash(String(v));
    for (var k in SITES) {
      if (trimSlash(SITES[k].url) === v) return v;
    }
  }
  return trimSlash(cfg.url);
}

let siteName = String(cache.get("siteName") || "一夜春宵");
let siteCfg = SITES[siteName] || SITES["一夜春宵"];
let mul = siteCfg.mul;
let host = getHost(siteName, siteCfg);
source.setVariable(host);

const sourceType = Object.keys(myFx);
// 首次导入 infoMap 为空，默认显示「小说」分类
let mySelect = infoMap["sel"] || sourceType[0];
if (!infoMap["sel"]) infoMap["sel"] = mySelect;
list.push({
	 "title": "sel",
	 "viewName": "'模式'",
	 "type": "select",
	 "action": "java.refreshExplore()",
	 "chars": sourceType,
	 "default": mySelect,
	 "style": {"layout_flexBasisPercent":1,"layout_flexGrow":1}
})

try{
  myFx[String(mySelect)].forEach(fx => {
	   let {title, content, tpl, size} = fx;

	   content.split("
").forEach(x => {
      let [n, u] = x.split("::");
      if (/^\d+$/.test(u)) u = String(Number(u) * mul);
      push(n, host + tpl.split("$$").join(u), size??0.29)
	   })
  })
}catch(e){java.longToast("

infoMap.save();

function decrypt(encryptedString) {
    let encryptedData_ = String(java.base64Decode(encryptedString));
    let controlNum = parseInt(encryptedData_.slice(8, 11));
    //java.log(controlNum)
    let text = encryptedData_.slice(controlNum + 11, encryptedData_.length - controlNum);
     let encryptedData = text.replace(/_/g,"8L3A+").replace(/-/g, "PHA+");
     return java.base64Decode(encryptedData);
}

var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))

var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }

    var state = saved ? JSON.parse(String(saved)) : null

  } catch (e) {}
  return {pages:{}}
}

function qmVideoUploadIds(kind, page) {
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  if (page == '1') {
    qmResetVideoState.call(this, kind)
    return []
  }
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var ids = []
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b) }).forEach(function (key) {
    if (Number(key) < Number(page)) ids = ids.concat(state.pages[key] || [])
  })
  var seen = {}
  return ids.filter(function (id) { id = String(id); if (!id || seen[id]) return false; seen[id] = 1; return true }).slice(-120).map(function (id) {
    return {id:String(id),item_type:kind == 'animated' ? '14' : '11',ts:String(Date.now()),type:'0'}
  })
}

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered
}

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {
  var ctx = this

  if (Array.isArray(node)) {

    return
  }
  if (typeof node != 'object') return
  var itemMode = mode == 'publish' ? 'novel' : mode
  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {
    var key = mode + '-' + id
    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = 1
      output.push(qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, node, itemMode, mode))
    }
  }
  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!/^(meta|stat_params|track_id|tag_items|category_list|rank_list)$/.test(key)) {
      qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, node[key], mode, output, seen, depth + 1)
    }
  })
}

function qmDateText(value) {

  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + two(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + two(date.getDate()) + ' ' + two(date.getHours()) + ':' + two(date.getMinutes())
}

function qmNovelInfo(raw) {
  raw = raw || {}
  var info = {}
  Object.keys(raw).forEach(function (key) { info[key] = raw[key] })
  var tags = (raw.book_tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return String(x.title || '') }).filter(function (x) { return !!x })
  var attribute = raw.attribute || {}
  var extras = attribute.extra_info_list || []
  function findExtra(pattern) {
    for (var i = 0; i < extras.length; i++) {
      if (pattern.test(String(extras[i].sub_title || extras[i].title || ''))) return qmExtraInfoText(extras[i])
    }
    return ''
  }
  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)
  if (score && String(score).indexOf('分') < 0) score = String(score) + '分'
  var reading = ''
  var readingList = attribute.reading_info_list || []
  if (readingList.length > 2) reading = qmExtraInfoText(readingList[2]) || String(readingList[2].title || readingList[2].text || '')
  if (!reading) reading = findExtra(/正在阅读|在线/)
  var lines = []
  var updated = qmDateText(raw.update_time)
  if (updated) lines.push('🧭 更新：' + updated)
  if (raw.category_over_words) lines.push('📒 关于：' + raw.category_over_words)
  if (score) lines.push('💯 分数：' + score)
  if (reading) lines.push('👁️ 在线：' + reading)
  if (tags.length) lines.push('🏷️ 标签：' + tags.join(' / '))
  if (raw.characters) lines.push('👥 角色：' + raw.characters)
  if (raw.publisher) lines.push('🏢 出版：' + raw.publisher)
  if (raw.isbn) lines.push('🔖 ISBN：' + raw.isbn)
  var copyright = raw.statement || raw.source_name
  if (copyright) lines.push('📍 版权来源：' + copyright)
  if (raw.intro) lines.push('📄 简介：' + raw.intro)
  info.id = String(raw.id || '')
  info.author = raw.author || raw.author_name || ''
  info.image_link = raw.big_image_link || raw.image_link || raw.thumb_image_link || ''
  info.intro = lines.join('\n')
  info.kind = [raw.category_over_words].concat(tags).filter(function (x) { return !!x }).join(',')
  info.last_chapter = raw.latest_chapter_title || raw.chapter_list_desc || ''
  info.words_num = raw.words_num || raw.word_count || ''
  return info
}

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {

    var data

    var total = ''
    var next = ''

      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}

      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')

      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor

      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'

      data = response.data || {}

function qmOpenComment(kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId) {
  var html = qmCommentHtml.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId)
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'showBrowser')) return false
  runtimeJava.showBrowser('https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/', html, 'window.java=java;window.cache=cache;window.source=source;window.qmRun=run;window.qmLocalCommentPage=true;', JSON.stringify({state:4,isHideable:true,heightPercentage:cfg.height,widthPercentage:1.0,dismissOnTouchOutside:true,skipCollapsed:true,expandedCornersRadius:16,isGestureInsetBottomIgnored:true,hardwareAccelerated:true,webViewInitialScale:100}))
  return true
}

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var normalizedKind = String(kind || '')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var color = cfg.color
  count = Number(count || 0)
  if (count <= 0) return ''
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph' && cfg.split) color = hot ? cfg.hotColor : count >= cfg.splitCount ? cfg.splitColor : cfg.color
  count = Math.min(count, 999)
  var svg
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph') {
    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :
      '<svg viewBox="5 14 45 36" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="180" height="144"><path d="M44 48 Q48 48 48 44 L48 20 Q48 16 44 16 L20 16 Q16 16 16 20 L16 24 S16 28 10 30 Q6 32 10 34 Q16 36 16 38 L16 44 Q16 48 20 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.7"/><text x="32" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="' + color + '" dominant-baseline="middle">' + displayText + '</text></svg>'
  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="6" y="6" width="988" height="116" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="3"/><text x="48" y="79" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="' + color + '">' + qmEsc(label) + '</text><text x="950" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="34" fill="' + color + '">' + count + ' 条 ›</text></svg>'
  } else {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="150" y="150" width="665" height="525" rx="175" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="18"/><text x="480" y="535" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="middle" font-size="298" fill="' + color + '">' + count + '</text></svg>'
  }
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + [normalizedKind, bid, cid, pid, label || '', checkId || ''].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var style = normalizedKind == 'paragraph' ? qmCommentConfig.call(this).svgSize : 'FULL'
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:style,type:'qmpl',click:call})
}

function qmBubbleImage(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var data = qmSvg.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot)
  return data ? '<img src="' + data + '">' : ''
}

function qmGodImage(bid, cid, pid, gid, text) {
  text = String(text || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim()
  if (!gid || !text) return ''
  if (text.length > 18) text = text.slice(0, 18) + '...'
  var svg = '<svg width="1000" height="120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' +
    '<rect x="2" y="0" width="996" height="100" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" rx="35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>' +
    '<rect x="32" y="22" width="140" height="56" rx="20" fill="#FF4444"/>' +
    '<text x="102" y="64" font-size="32" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">神评</text>' +
    '<text x="196" y="64" font-size="38" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">' + qmEsc(text) + '</text></svg>'
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + ['paragraph', bid, cid, pid, '七猫神评', gid].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var data = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:'FULL',type:'qmpl-god',click:call})
  return '<img src="' + data + '">'
}

function qmChapterReviewCount(bid, cid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-chapter-' + bid + '-' + cid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/comment/chapter-end-comment', {book_id:bid,chapter_ids:cid}).data || {}
  var comments = data.comments || []
  var count = comments.length ? Number(comments[0].count || 0) : 0
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmBookReviewCount(bid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-book-' + bid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', {circle_id:bid,need_common:'0',tag_id:'1',book_id:bid,sort:'0'}).data || {}
  var count = Number(data.evaluates_info && data.evaluates_info.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || 0)
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmContentTitle(value, baseUrl) {
  var text = String(value || '')
  var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
  try { if (runtimeChapter) runtimeChapter.putImgUrl(null) } catch (e) {}
  return text
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

        var chart = {
            "id": o.id,
            "title": o.cN,
            "v": o.sS == 0,
            "t": o.uT + "  " + o.cnt + "字"

        var content_url = {
            bookId: bookId,
            id: o.id,
            v: o.sS == 0
        }
        content_url = java.base64Encode(JSON.stringify(content_url));

        charts.push(chart);
    })
})

var pages = java.getElements('tag.select@option');

  var url = baseUrl.replace('/1/', '/' + i + '/');
  var resp = java.ajax(url);
  java.setContent(resp);
  resp = java.getStringList('//ul[@class="section-list fix ycxsid"]/li/a');

  for (let j = 0; j < resp.length; j ++) {
    var rr = resp[j].match(/<a href="(.*?)">(.*?)<\/a>/);
    var title = rr[2], href = rr[1];
    if (set[title]) continue;
    var order = href.match(/\/(\d+)\.html/)[1];
    res.push(JSON.stringify({ title, href, order }));
    set[title] = true;
  }
}
res.sort((a, b) => {
  a = JSON.parse(a);
  b = JSON.parse(b);
  return a.order - b.order;
});
res;
</js>
